objective: Produce a deterministic, schema-valid parent-first straight ChainRigTemplate from explicit start/end/boneCount, with correct bone positions, length, rotation, parents, and clear rig-stage errors for degenerate input.
inScope: Generate an engine-neutral RigSpec chain with explicit root world position, child parent-local offsets, equal positive segment lengths, and deterministic IDs/order.
Add a thin rig-chain CLI with no-overwrite behavior and structured errors.
Check independent forward kinematics, input rejection, 100-run exact serialization, and all earlier Gate regressions.
outOfScope: Inferring pivots/joints from art, curved or unequal-length bones, attachment binding, weights, deformation, animations, production-rig approval, or general multi-bone Spine JSON serialization.
assumptions: Input start and end are explicit world coordinates, and boneCount counts deform-chain segments, not a separate control root.
Root x/y are world coordinates; each child x/y and rotation are parent-local setup transforms. Angles use atan2(dy,dx) in degrees; every segment has length hypot(dx,dy)/boneCount.
At most 256 bones is a Gate 4 safety bound, not a Spine runtime limit or an artist-optimal density recommendation.
implementationSummary: generateChainRig validates object/id/name, exactly two finite coordinates at each endpoint, integer bone count 1..256, nonzero finite total length and representable positive per-segment length. It emits RigSpec 0.1 type chain with N bones in parent-first order. The root has x/y=start and rotation=atan2(end-start) degrees. Each child has parentId=previous id, x=segment length, y=0, rotation=0; every bone length=segment length. No randomness, clocks, Spine import, asset-dependent inference, weights or constraints. CLI reads JSON, invokes this function, and creates output only after validation with exclusive-create wx.

checks.name: Developer full verification
checks.evidence: On 2026-09-24, npm run verify passed Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/typecheck, and Vitest: 9 files / 69 tests all passed. The first sandbox run failed only because Windows denied child-process creation (EPERM) for both existing and new CLI tests; the same suite was rerun with process-spawn permission and passed completely.

checks.name: Independent bone math and RigSpec schema
checks.evidence: Four valid fixtures cover one bone, vertical upward, diagonal from negative coordinates, and reversed diagonal. TypeBox RigSpecSchema checks each result. A test-only forward-kinematics evaluator accumulates parent transforms and rotates local child x/y; it asserts each world joint lies at start+i*(end-start)/N and the last tip reaches end to 10 decimal places. Every root/child rotation, length, ID, parentId and order is asserted.

checks.name: Degenerate input and CLI safety
checks.evidence: Eleven invalid cases assert structured stage=rig/severity=3 codes for null/missing/blank fields, nonfinite points, zero/fractional/>256 count, identical endpoints and overflow length. CLI smoke verifies a three-bone vertical chain, source unchanged, existing output not overwritten, same input/output rejected, and invalid inputs emit RIG_ZERO_LENGTH with no output file.

checks.name: Determinism, regression, architecture
checks.evidence: A 13-bone diagonal fixture has byte-identical JSON.stringify across 100 generations. All 50 earlier Gate tests remain included in the passing 69-test suite, including the Gate 3.2 matched artist vertex hard-precheck tests, mesh CLI and topology fixtures. A package-boundary test asserts Rig depends only on @autospine/schemas and contains no Spine/Mesh/Assets/Core/Jev imports. No prior package algorithms or IR schemas changed.

knownLimitations: The template is a straight, equal-length starter rig, not a learned recreation of the artist's specific bone placement.
No mesh binding, weights, deformation, automatic joint inference, or broad Spine 4.0.64 exporter was implemented or tested in this Gate.
The 256-bone bound is a defensive input limit; rig quality and appropriate bone count remain an artistic decision.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Explicit start/end/boneCount produces a correct RigSpec chain with lengths, positions, rotation and parent links
definitionOfDone.evidence: Independent forward-kinematics unit tests for four directions plus RigSpec schema check and exact parent/length/rotation assertions.
Eleven negative test cases verify structured stage=rig error codes; CLI writes no output on failure.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Fixed input yields fixed output and prior Gates do not regress
definitionOfDone.evidence: 100 exact serializations and full 69-test suite including all 50 prior-Gate cases.
